offer.subclass: Calcium HMB with explicitly declared HMB payload
offer.basis: Official unflavoured supplement-facts table states one 3000 mg scoop: calcium beta-hydroxy beta-methylbutyrate monohydrate (CaHMB) 3000 mg, of which HMB 2475 mg and labelled calcium 465 mg. Net size and Unflavored choice are matched to one exact child ID.
offer.notes: HMB payload 2475 mg is explicitly declared by the manufacturer, not a molecular conversion calculated by this catalog. The 3000 mg calcium HMB compound and 2475 mg HMB payload overlap and must not be added together. No free-acid HMB equivalent or calories are inferred. Official exact child finalPrice is published inclusive of tax in INR, but child-level availability is absent from public configurable data; stock must be confirmed.
